messages:
noah: hey team — first day here! my Okta activation link says "expired" and I never got the 1Password invite. also trying to register my YubiKey and the browser just says "device not recognized". any quick steps? :wave:

it-support: welcome noah! :tada: can you DM your work email so we can resend the Okta + 1Password invites? quick checks: look in spam, try the invite link in an incognito window, or another browser (Chrome tends to be the most reliable for passkeys/Yubi).

noah: thanks — sent DM with noah@redwood.dev. I tried Safari and Firefox on macOS, expired message showed up immediately when I clicked the link. 1Password mail not in spam either.

it-support: got it — resending now. FYI Okta activation links are 24h by default, and links can be single-use. If you still see the expired notice after a resend, try: 1) open an incognito window 2) paste the full activation URL (don’t click a cached bookmark) 3) ensure your system clock is correct (weird but it matters for SSO).

marie (people-ops): hey noah, welcome to Redwood! I confirmed we resent both invites a minute ago. look for an email from "accounts@redwood.com" — if it doesn't arrive in 5 min ping me and i'll escalate to the admin console. :slightly_smiling_face:

samir (security): re YubiKey: for macOS using Safari, prefer enroll via Chrome for WebAuthn/Yubi interaction. also make sure your YubiKey has a PIN set and try touching it when the browser prompt appears. if using a passkey instead of a hardware key, enroll via the "Add passkey" flow in Okta (Security -> Passkeys). if Linux, you may need libu2f or yubikey-manager (ykman) installed.

noah: tried the new link in Chrome incognito and that worked — Okta activated. 1Password invite showed up after resend and I was able to set master password. YubiKey still not recognized in Safari but enrollment succeeded in Chrome. thanks all! :white_check_mark:

it-support: awesome — marking this resolved but leave thread open for any followups. if you want the YubiKey tested in System Preferences > Security & Privacy -> Privacy > Input Monitoring, we can remote in.

it-bot: Reminder: new-hires checklist updated — please complete account setup and mark "Onboarding: Accounts" done in the People Ops board.

noah: done and marked complete. super smooth now, appreciate the quick help! :pray:
